title: IB May 2028 Exam Dates: What We Know So Far
summary: IB May 2028 exam dates are provisionally 25 April–19 May, with no exams on 1 May. See what is verified and what still awaits official confirmation from the IB.
body_markdown:
The **IB May 2028 exam dates are provisionally Tuesday 25 April to Friday 19 May 2028, with no examinations on 1 May** . These dates appear in the IB’s final May 2027 examination schedule, which explicitly says they are “subject to confirmation in 2026”.


A search of publicly available IB information for this article did not identify a separate full May 2028 timetable or a subsequent official confirmation. Students starting the Diploma Programme and coordinators should therefore treat this as a provisional examination window; individual subject and paper dates have not been verified.


### What the IB has published


The source is the IB’s **May 2027 examination schedule, final version, covering all exam zones A, B and C** . Under its “2028 examination Schedule” heading, it states:


> “The examination schedule in 2028 will start on Tuesday 25 April 2028, and end on Friday 19 May 2028 (with no exams on 1 May), subject to confirmation in 2026.”


The wording can be checked in this[school-hosted copy of the IB’s final May 2027 schedule](https://mhsib.weebly.com/uploads/1/3/8/5/138557084/may_2027_final_examination_schedule.pdf) .


The distinction between the document’s title and its forward-looking note matters. **“Final version” applies to the May 2027 timetable.** The same document separately qualifies its 2028 dates as subject to confirmation.


Its reference to confirmation in 2026 is an expected confirmation timeframe. That wording alone does not establish that confirmation subsequently happened.


Detail Verified position for May 2028


Session start Tuesday 25 April 2028, provisional


Session end Friday 19 May 2028, provisional


1 May No examinations planned, within the provisional announcement


Full subject and paper timetable Not located in the public sources checked for this article


Subsequent official confirmation Not located in the public sources checked for this article


The absence of a timetable from the sources checked is a limit of this report’s verification. It does not establish that schools have received no further information. A coordinator can clarify whether a school holds a more recent IB communication.


### How this compares with May 2027


The final May 2027 session runs from **Friday 23 April to Tuesday 18 May 2027** . The provisional 2028 window begins two calendar dates later in April and finishes one calendar date later in May.


There is also a useful qualification to the 2027 opening date: Friday 23 April contains the afternoon examinations for school-based syllabus SL paper 1 and Language & culture SL paper 1. The following week’s examinations begin on Monday 26 April.


These are session boundaries, so they do not describe every student’s personal examination period. A student’s first and last written papers depend on their subjects and levels.


The 2027 timetable also provides no verified basis for assigning particular subjects to dates in 2028. Students should avoid assuming that mathematics, sciences or language papers will occupy the same relative positions next year.


### What students and coordinators can use now


For students preparing for **IB exams 2028** , the provisional window provides a broad reference for the end of the course. It does not yet support a confirmed countdown to an individual paper or a detailed calendar of examination gaps.


The planned break on 1 May is part of the same provisional statement. It identifies a day without examinations within that window, but it does not establish the placement of any student’s papers on the days immediately before or after it.


Coordinators using the dates in school calendars should retain the provisional label and the source’s confirmation caveat. Once a full schedule is available, the relevant details will include each paper’s date, morning or afternoon session, duration and applicable local start time.


When a school shares an updated calendar, students can check whether it cites a newer IB schedule or repeats the forward-looking 2027 note. That source distinction determines whether the dates can be described as confirmed.


Students considering travel or other commitments around the examination period should check with their coordinator before treating either boundary as final. Even after the session dates are confirmed, their own last examination may fall before the session’s closing day.


The[IB’s official examination schedule page](https://www.ibo.org/programmes/diploma-programme/assessment-and-exams/exam-schedule/) is the public reference point for published DP and CP schedules. A full **IB exam schedule 2028** , or an explicit IB confirmation of the session window, would provide the evidence needed to update the provisional status reported here.
